description: Keys out a plain background (green screen, blue screen, a plain wall) with ffmpeg on this machine. The colour is found from the edges of the first frame, or given as hex. Writes a transparent WebM (VP9 with alpha, for video editors and the web) or an MP4 on a new background colour; the sound is kept. For people or objects in front of an ordinary background, use the AI version on app.ionelul.com/video-background-remover. Needs ffmpeg installed.

background.description: Put the subject on this colour and write MP4; omit for a transparent WebM

color.description: Background colour to remove, e.g. "#00b140" (default: detected from the frame edges)

output.description: Default: <name>-transparent.webm or <name>-background.mp4 next to the video

tolerance.description: How far from the colour still counts as background (default 30)

name: video_remove_background
title: Remove a video background by its colour
